literal: deep in water will conquer crocodile will kill from water if leaves it others
translation: In deep water, a crocodile can conquer anything. But if it leaves the water, other creatures will defeat it.
modern: ஆழமான நீரில் இருக்கும்போது முதலை மற்ற உயிரினங்களை வெல்லும். ஆனால் அந்த நீரை விட்டு வெளியே வந்தால், மற்ற உயிரினங்கள் அந்த முதலையை வென்றுவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet illustrates the absolute importance of choosing the right environment for success. In its natural habitat of deep water, a crocodile is invincible and can defeat any opponent. However, if it steps out of the water, it loses its natural advantage and becomes vulnerable to other animals. The imagery emphasizes that even the strongest individuals can be easily defeated if they operate outside their domain of strength.
